# `acknowledgement-stale`

An acknowledgement's finding no longer appears

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `info` |
| **Rule IDs** | `acknowledgement-stale` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M6) |
| **Group** | Spec and engine notices ([RULES.md section 11](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An entry in the acknowledgements file names a finding ID that no longer appears: the change was fixed, or the finding changed and got a new ID.

## Why this default

Notice only: the file should be cleaned up so it lists only accepted findings.

## Example

From test case [`acknowledgement-stale`](../../test/cases/acknowledgement-stale/): An acknowledgement names a finding ID that doesn't appear (the change was fixed or reworded): acknowledgement-stale (info) says to remove it. The real removal is not covered.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
          '200':
            description: ok
-   '/pets/{id}':
-     delete:
-       responses:
-         '200':
-           description: ok
```

Findings:

- `operation-removed` · error · DELETE /pets/{id}
- `acknowledgement-stale` · info · acknowledgement-stale/expected.yaml

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. See [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  acknowledgement-stale: info
```

## How to fix

Remove the entry, or acknowledge the finding under its new ID.
